summary: Family foundry (95 staff, EUR 14.8 M); we are 7.1 % of its turnover, so we matter. A large heating customer cancelled its 2027 orders (Oct 2026) and its bank is watching its liquidity: it asks for 10-day payment and firm Q1 call-offs. Power and material bought forward until December 2028: it will dismiss index arguments. Casing cover HB is sole-sourced at cost; Pump housing HB 40 is 35 % dearer than co-source 70150 (32.24 vs 43.39). Qualified but unused on three more parts, a strong volume carrot.
